## About
Body Rocks Paint & Body is a complete auto body repair facility on Main Street in Watauga, Texas. We've built our reputation on honesty and integrity, and our goal is to get your vehicle back on the road quickly and efficiently at the best value.
We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles, from minor dents and dings to bringing a car back to pre-accident condition. We offer free estimates, pick-up and drop-off service, and direct insurance billing to make accident repair as hassle-free as we can.
We have built our life around this community. Reviewers mention Jackie, Dave and Bri by name, and we hold a 4.8 rating from 249 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision & Auto Body Repair: Collision repair for all makes and models, from minor dents and dings to bringing your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.
- Automotive Paint: Paint work done in our own shop, plus vehicle painting and restoration.
- Paintless Dent Removal: Minor dents taken out without sanding or body filler, so your vehicle keeps its original finish.
- Auto Glass Services: Windshield repair and replacement, from a few rock chips to a full replacement, installed and matched to your vehicle.
- Alloy Wheel Repair: We fix curb rash, nicks and scrapes so you don't have to buy new wheels.
- Auto Upholstery: Upholstery for the inside of your car, truck or SUV, with a range of materials to choose from.

## FAQ
Q: Do you bill my insurance?
A: Yes. We offer direct insurance billing, and we can help with towing and a rental car too.

Q: Do I have to take my car back to the dealer to keep its warranty?
A: No. Having it serviced somewhere other than where you bought it doesn't void the warranty.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Is there a warranty on glass work?
A: We offer a written lifetime warranty on auto glass replacements. Give us a call for the details.
